style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">S&#38;P Global Reports Third Quarter Results&#59; Announces Strategic Review for Capital IQ </font></div><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">and Associated Data Businesses</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">New York, NY, October&#160;27, 2026 &#8211; S&#38;P Global (NYSE&#58; SPGI) today reported third quarter results. This earnings release and supplemental materials are available at http&#58;&#47;&#47;investor.spglobal.com&#47;Quarterly-Earnings.</font></div><div style="margin-top:12pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:103%">The Company reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $3.678&#160;billion, an increase of 7% compared to the third quarter of 2025. Third quarter GAAP net income increased 20% to $1.298&#160;billion and GAAP diluted earnings per share increased 26% to $4.45. Adjusted net income for the third quarter increased 4% to $1.337 billion and adjusted diluted earnings per share increased 9% to $4.58. Higher GAAP net income was driven by growth in operating profit, including the benefit from a gain on disposition in Energy. Higher adjusted net income was driven primarily by growth in adjusted operating profit, partially offset by higher taxes in the quarter. </font></div><div style="margin-top:12pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:102%">The Company has initiated a strategic review of alternatives, including potential separation, for Capital IQ and associated data businesses, which constitute the majority of Kensho Data &#38; Platforms within Market Intelligence. While the exact perimeter remains under review, the Company expects to retain RatingsDirect, RatingsXpress, and Enterprise Solutions. Capital IQ and the associated data businesses are well positioned to grow and thrive, and we believe separate ownership could provide dedicated investment and focus, positioning these businesses to accelerate innovation and growth.</font></div><div style="margin-top:12pt;text-align:justify"><table style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%">Total revenue and organic constant currency revenue are now expected to be higher than the previous guidance ranges of 5.9% to 7.9% and 6.0% to 8.0%, respectively, both driven by higher expected revenue from the Ratings and Indices divisions. GAAP operating margin expansion is expected to be below the prior range of 335 to 360 basis points primarily due to adjustments to expected gain on dispositions, partially offset by higher revenue growth. Higher revenue growth and continued expense discipline are expected to drive adjusted operating margin expansion above the prior range of 35 to 60 basis points. GAAP diluted EPS is expected to be lower than the prior guidance range of $16.35 to $16.60 primarily due to adjustments to expected gain on dispositions, partially offset by higher revenue. Adjusted diluted EPS is expected to be higher than the prior guidance range of $17.50 to $17.75, driven by the combined impact of higher revenue and margin expansion. Non-GAAP adjusted guidance excludes amortization of intangibles related to acquisitions and acquisition and disposition-related costs.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%">There is no specific timeframe for the strategic review we announced, and there can be no assurance that the review will result in any transaction or particular outcome. The Company also refers to and presents certain additional non-GAAP financial measures, within the meaning of Regulation G under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.  These measures are&#58; organic revenue&#59; organic constant currency revenue&#59; adjusted net income&#59; adjusted diluted EPS&#59; adjusted operating profit and margin&#59; adjusted expenses&#59; adjusted corporate unallocated expense&#59; adjusted deal-related amortization&#59; adjusted interest expense, net&#59; adjusted income before taxes on income&#59; adjusted provision for income taxes&#59; adjusted effective tax rate&#59; adjusted equity in income on unconsolidated subsidiaries&#59; free cash flow&#59; and adjusted free cash flow, excluding certain items.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">The Company has included reconciliations of these non-GAAP financial measures to the most directly comparable financial measures calculated in accordance with GAAP on Exhibits 5, 7 and 8.  The Company is not able to provide reconciliations of certain forward-looking non-GAAP financial measures to comparable GAAP measures because certain items required for such reconciliations are outside of the Company's control and&#47;or cannot be reasonably predicted without unreasonable effort.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">The Company's non-GAAP measures include adjustments that reflect how management views our businesses.  The Company believes these non-GAAP financial measures provide useful supplemental information that, in the case of non-GAAP financial measures other than free cash flow and adjusted free cash flow, excluding certain items, enables investors to better compare the Company's performance across periods, and management also uses these measures internally to assess the operating performance of its business, to assess performance for employee compensation purposes and to decide how to allocate resources.  The Company believes that the presentation of free cash flow and adjusted free cash flow, excluding certain items allows investors to evaluate the cash generated from our underlying operations in a manner similar to the method used by management and that such measures are useful in evaluating the cash available to us to prepay debt, make strategic acquisitions and investments, and repurchase stock.  However, investors should not consider any of these non-GAAP measures in isolation from, or as a substitute for, the financial information that the Company reports.</font></div><div style="height:60.75pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Page 4 </font></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:29.25pt;width:100%"><div style="text-align:right"><table style="border-collapse:collapse;display:inline-table;margin-bottom:5pt;vertical-align:text-bottom;width:88.188%"><tr><td style="width:1.0%"></td><td style="width:32.233%"></td><td style="width:0.1%"></td><td style="width:1.0%"></td><td style="width:32.233%"></td><td style="width:0.1%"></td><td style="width:1.0%"></td><td style="width:32.234%"></td><td style="width:0.1%"></td></tr><tr style="height:15pt"><td colspan="3" style="padding:0 1pt"></td><td colspan="3" style="padding:0 1pt"></td><td colspan="3" style="padding:0 1pt"></td></tr></table></div></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:115%">Forward-Looking Statements&#58; </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%">This press release contains &#8220;forward-looking statements,&#8221; as defined in the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995. style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Represents a change equal to or in excess of 100% or not meaningful</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:8.5pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> </font></div><div style="margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:3pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Note - Financial information presented reflects the Company's results on a continuing operations basis, and prior periods have been recast accordingly to conform to this presentation. Segment results also reflect the effect of the recast outlined in our press release dated July 6, 2026.</font></div><div style="padding-left:27pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">(a)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Subscription revenue is primarily derived from distribution of data, valuation services, analytics, third party research, and credit ratings-related information through both feed and web-based channels, market data and market insights along with other information products.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;margin-top:6pt;padding-left:27pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(b)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Non-subscription &#47; transaction revenue is primarily related to ratings of publicly-issued debt and bank loan ratings.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;margin-top:6pt;padding-left:27pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(c)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Non-transaction revenue is primarily related to surveillance of a credit rating, annual fees for customer relationship-based pricing programs, fees for entity credit ratings and global research and analytics at Crisil. Non-transaction revenue also includes an intersegment revenue elimination charged to Market Intelligence for the rights to use and distribute content and data developed by Ratings.</font></div><div style="height:15.75pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div><font><br></font></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:42.75pt;width:100%"><div style="text-align:right"><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Exhibit 6</font></div></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;margin-top:6pt;padding-left:27pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(d)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Asset-linked fees is primarily related to fees based on assets underlying exchange-traded funds, mutual funds and insurance products. </font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;margin-top:6pt;padding-left:27pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(e)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Sales usage-based royalty revenue is primarily related to trading based fees from exchange-traded derivatives and licensing proprietary market price data and price assessments to commodity exchanges.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;margin-top:6pt;padding-left:27pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">(f)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Recurring variable revenue represents revenue from contracts for services that specify a fee based on, among other factors, the number of trades processed, assets under management, or the number of positions valued.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt;margin-top:6pt;padding-left:27pt;text-align:justify"><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:center"><font><br></font></div><div
